attr.title: N.O.V.A. 2: Near Orbit Vanguard Alliance
attr.desc: N.O.V.A. 2 Android v1.0.3 for ARM Linux handhelds. Supply your own exact APK and complete game-data directory; the first launch validates and imports them.
attr.inst: Install nova2.zip through PortMaster. Copy your owned N.O.V.A. 2 Android v1.0.3 APK and the complete gameloft/games/GloftN2HP directory to ports/nova2/. First launch imports the data. No game data is included. Display resolution is automatic; put WIDTHxHEIGHT in nova2/resolution.txt to override it.
